name_zh: 科特迪瓦·费利克斯·乌弗埃-博瓦尼：稳定可可与法国和平大教堂奇迹
name_en: Ivory Coast Felix Houphouet-Boigny: Stability Cocoa & France Peace Cathedral Miracle
description_zh: 费利克斯·乌弗埃-博瓦尼 (1905-1993) 科特迪瓦首任总统 (1960-1993)，可可出口经济奇迹，与法国维持特殊关系，亚穆苏克罗和平大教堂世界最大教堂，三十年稳定后继任者内战。
description_en: Felix Houphouet-Boigny (1905-1993) Ivory Coast first President (1960-1993), cocoa export economic miracle, special France relationship, Yamoussoukro Basilica worlds largest church, thirty years stability successors civil war.
reason_zh: 乌弗埃代表法语非洲通过单一作物出口与前殖民宗主国共生实现稳定的典范，展示了和平大教堂如何作为宗教与权力双重象征投射国家形象，其继任者内战揭示了稳定模式的脆弱性。
reason_en: Houphouet-Boigny represents Francophone Africa stability paradigm through single crop export and former colonizer symbiosis, demonstrating how Peace Basilica serves as religious and power dual symbol projecting national image, his successors civil war revealing stability model fragility.
steps_zh: 研究乌弗埃早年医生与法属西非议员经历
分析可可出口经济奇迹与法国军事经济特权
探讨亚穆苏克罗和平大教堂建造与宗教外交
评估1993年逝世后贝迪埃/塔瓦拉/巴博内继任内战
总结稳定可可法国和平大教堂奇迹对法语西非发展模式的示范与局限
steps_en: Study Houphouet-Boigny early doctor and French West Africa deputy experience
Analyze cocoa export economic miracle and France military economic privileges
Explore Yamoussoukro Basilica construction and religious diplomacy
Evaluate 1993 death and Bedie/Tavara/Babone successors civil war
Summarize stability cocoa France peace cathedral miracle demonstration and limits for Francophone West African development model
expected_zh: 理解单一作物经济与前宗主国共生如何构建稳定契约，掌握宗教宏大叙事如何掩盖政治继承未解难题，评估乌弗埃模式对喀麦隆加蓬等法语非洲稳定契约的启示与警示。
expected_en: Understand how single crop economy and former colonizer symbiosis builds stability contract, grasp how religious grand narrative masks political succession unresolved issues, evaluate Houphouet-Boigny model lessons and warnings for Cameroon Gabon Francophone African stability contracts.
case_zh: 1960 总统；可可奇迹；大教堂；1993 逝世内战。稳定可可法国大教堂奇迹范式永存。
case_en: 1960 President; cocoa miracle; Basilica; 1993 death civil war. Stability cocoa France peace cathedral miracle paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Francophone African Stability / Cocoa Economy / Religious Diplomacy
cross_cultural_impact: Cocoa economy; France relationship; Peace Basilica; civil war succession
